Fresh install; no seeded history or goals

Current flow. First install asks only for Android usage access. Once access is enabled, Phone Sense records completion with its internal Saturday and 07:00 defaults and opens Home directly. Notification permission, notification time, and week start are not presented during onboarding.

Required usage access

Dark mode

Owner review notes

  • The notification, notification-time, and week-start choices are absent from first install as intended.
  • Full justification creates visibly wide spaces on several lines of the usage explanation, especially around short words.
  • Android’s usage-access explanation mentions carrier, language, and other details beyond the app’s narrower explanation.
  • A fresh Home can contain a small non-zero total because time spent in Android settings is real foreground usage.

Older Android behavior

Usage-access labels, list layout, toggle presentation, and wording are system interfaces and vary by Android release and device maker. The Phone Sense flow remains the same: explanation, Android usage-access settings, then Home.
